name: missing-await-on-async-write
description: A refactor drops `await` on an async DB write, so errors are swallowed and writes can race. Classic correctness bug that lives entirely inside the diff.

pr.title: Simplify cache write path
pr.body: Tidy up the write path in the cache layer.
pr.author: alice
pr.head: refactor/cache-write

expectedFinding.summary: Dropped `await` on `this.db.write(...)`: write errors are no longer surfaced and the method resolves before the write completes, so callers can observe stale reads.
